notes: Terra Santa Propriedades (LAND3) spun off from Terra Santa Agro in 2021 as B3-listed exclusively-rural-real-estate vehicle. All 7 owned farms in Mato Grosso (39,189 ha = 96,840 acres useful area), leased on 25-yr contract to SLC Agrícola starting 2021 — annual revenue = ~17 sacks of soybeans per leased hectare. Annual S&P Global laudo de avaliação (Nov base date). Quarterly data from InfoMoney + IR press releases. Some early-2022 + 2024 quarters partially backfilled.
